gaps: Confirm the exact kit BOM, radio band, installed build, antennas and accessories before ordering; the bare PCB is not the finished kit.
Battery capacity, battery connector/polarity, enclosure dimensions and any included GPS are not established.

Wiring documentation differs by build: the mapper README shows D4/D5 and mentions a GPIO6/7 variant. The two pinned S3 sources and current flasher specify GPIO5/6. Match the actual firmware and board before wiring.
Detection needs a supported Remote ID broadcast; neither detection range nor LoRa relay range was tested here.
The earlier profile reported an obsolete BLE RemoteID to Mesh link. That link was not restored; retained alternative project resources are not a promise of current maintenance.
notes: The pinned source review is commit 3373e4e83da30f34af321a27815d74bc543ff5e0. Firmware roles and host features are not guaranteed contents of every retail kit.
